name: Selkip · Gremlet #25
description:
A selkie pup: a seal on the beach, a story by the fire. Mostly it just naps on warm rocks.

One of 50 one-of-a-kind Gremlets. Owning this token unlocks Selkip in the Gremlets desktop app, where it walks on your windows, naps, plays with other Gremlets and shows off its signature move.
